schema_version: 1
integrations:
  student_context:
    service: ms-go-student
    transport: HTTP
    authentication: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
    action_context:
      method: GET
      path: /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-actions/{learningActionID}/context
      semantics: ownership-scoped frozen task context; missing and foreign actions are both not found
      excludes: [answer identity, objective outcome, evidence class, evidence rows, mastery audit]
    action_code_context:
      method: GET
      path: /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-actions/{learningActionID}/code-context
      version: student-learning-action-code-context-v1
      semantics: exact open-action, text-only, secret-safe workspace projection plus latest sandbox-validation-observation-v1; missing Sandbox is explicit available false
      bounds: at most 12 files, 16 KiB per file, and 64 KiB total
      validation: only available, validation|tests kind, passed, issue_count, and checked_at; any workspace mutation invalidates it
      excludes: [answer identity, Sandbox identity, raw validator output, secret files and lines, dependencies, build output, binaries]
    mastery:
      method: POST
      path: /internal/students/{studentID}/mastery/query
      request: 1 to 100 exact ordered targets copied from the action snapshot
      response: one current projection per requested target in request order
      excludes: [raw evidence, reducer audit]
    learner_overview:
      method: GET
      path: /internal/students/{studentID}/learner-overview
      version: student-learner-overview-v2
      path_lifecycle: Student-owned status, is_primary, and is_selected; diagnostic active-path claims require exact ACTIVE path identity; overview is_selected is not authoritative selection context
      semantics: optional onboarding plus bounded current mastery/path/diagnostic and five recent learning sessions
      excludes: [raw evidence, reducer audit, answers, dialog history, prompts]
    assigned_lesson_context:
      method: GET
      path: /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/items/{itemID}/lesson-context
      authentication: existing exact shared X-Internal-Token read credential
      schema: student-assigned-lesson-context.v1
      fields: [schema, student_id, learning_path_id, learning_path_item_id, course_id, lesson_id, lesson_revision_id, content_digest, content]
      content: [title, excerpt, description]
      identity: exact Student owner, path, item, course, lesson, and immutable UUID LessonRevision
      content_digest: sha256 lowercase64 of Go encoding/json.Marshal([3]string{raw title, raw excerpt, raw description})
      bounds: title 1000 runes; excerpt 4000 runes; description 1 MiB valid UTF-8; one strict response at most 2 MiB
      failure: missing, foreign, malformed, digest drift, or unavailable context fails closed; no Course fallback
      privacy: full content is transient verification input only; no private tasks, answers, translations, or provider body
    learning_session:
      read:
        method: GET
        path: /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-sessions/{sessionID}
        semantics: exact ownership-scoped Student session; summary requires ended_at and analytics_session_id
      apply_metrics:
        method: PUT
        path: /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-sessions/{sessionID}/metrics
        semantics: optimistic projection of bounded Statistic counters onto the Student-owned session
    learning_workspace:
      authentication: dedicated exact STUDENT_SERVICE_TEACHER_TOKEN
      method: GET
      path: /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-workspace
      schema: student-learning-workspace.v1
      fields: [schema, context_version, optional selected_path]
      selected_path: [learning_path_id, course_id, ACTIVE status, path_version, position-ordered items]
      item: [reference_type lesson_or_practice, reference_id, position, status]
      item_status: [PLANNED, READY, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, SKIPPED_MASTERED]
      bounds: one strict JSON object at most 64 KiB; at most 500 items
      failure: non-200, redirect, media-type drift, unknown field, oversize, invalid identity/order/status, or multiple JSON values fail closed
      privacy: no Student body identity and no Planner request, handoff, execution, admission, prompt, or provider fields
    reliability:
      timeout_default_seconds: 3
      maximum_response_bytes: 2097152
      response_decoding: strict JSON with unknown fields rejected
      failure: fail closed; no cached or inferred personalization fallback in v1
    knowledge_tree_dependency: none
    target_owners:
      regular_task: ms-go-course
      practice_or_project_milestone: ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator immutable runtime revision
      teacher_input: ms-go-student frozen learning-action snapshot only
    teacher_onboarding_turn_s3:
      authentication: dedicated exact STUDENT_SERVICE_TEACHER_TOKEN; never browser credentials or the generic internal token
      apply:
        method: POST
        path: /internal/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns
        schema: student-onboarding-turn.v2
        idempotency: Idempotency-Key equals student_command_id
      replay:
        method: GET
        path: /internal/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns/{studentCommandID}
      prove_no_effect:
        method: POST
        path: /internal/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns/{studentCommandID}/prove-no-effect
        schema: student-onboarding-turn-no-effect-proof.v2
        idempotency: Idempotency-Key equals student_command_id
      result_schema: student-onboarding-turn-result.v2
      result_states: accepted|no_effect; unknown command is not found
      semantics: exact optimistic draft transition; Student is sole mutation/proof authority; same command replays and different command conflicts
      causality: action correlation is action_receipt_id and causation is teacher_job_id; semantic-text correlation is canonical_student_message_id and causation is ai_execution_id
      bounds: strict JSON; request at most 16 KiB; one to nine typed slots; no generic maps or browser/LLM payload passthrough
  practice_task_context:
    service: ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator
    transport: HTTP
    authentication: dedicated Practice Teacher token sent as exact X-Internal-Token; rejected by catalog and private evaluation routes
    read:
      method: GET
      path: /internal/task-instances/{instanceID}/teacher-context?student_id={studentID}
      version: practice-task-teacher-context.v1
      response: exact instance/revision/student, current public Step and acceptance, exact versioned targets, effective assistance policy, bounded sanitized workspace, and validation summary
      bounds: at most 12 files, 16 KiB per file, and 64 KiB total
      excludes: [private evaluation, reference solution, negative fixtures, hidden checks, raw validator output, Sandbox identity]
    validation_explanation:
      method: GET
      path: /internal/task-instances/{instanceID}/teacher-validation-explanation?student_id={studentID}
      version: practice-task-teacher-validation-context.v1
      scope: practice_task only; never project
      binding: exact task_instance_id, student_id, frozen task_revision_id, and learning_action_id must match the already normalized Practice context and Dialog request
      payload: submission_id, workspace_digest, updated_at, passed, and teacher-validation-explanation.v1 with at most five issues and 16 KiB serialized envelope
      allowlist: [code, message, hint, relative file, line, column, stage_id, engine, severity, truncated, source_digest]
      excludes: [raw stages, raw evidence, tests, code snapshots, private evaluation, selectors, routes, symbols, fixtures, rubrics, solutions, AI review, human review]
      authority: advisory prompt context only; never changes official pass, task status, evidence, mastery, or assistance policy
    assistance:
      method: POST
      path: /internal/task-instances/{instanceID}/teacher-assistance
      request: usage_id, student_id, and practice-task-assistance-usage.v1
      idempotency: TeacherDecision UUID is the immutable assistance usage ID
      mapping: hint to HINT, question to TEACHER_QUESTION, explanation/direction to TEACHER_EXPLANATION
      ordering: record in Practice after durable Teacher decision and before Dialog append; retry reuses the same ID
    mastery:
      source: Student exact mastery query for only the ordered targets returned by Practice
    policy:
      authority: Practice immutable effective policy caps the deterministic Teacher plan before AI Prompt
      no_complete_solution: always enforced
      zero_hint: explanation only when allowed, otherwise Socratic question
    reliability:
      timeout_default_seconds: 3
      maximum_response_bytes: 2097152
      response_decoding: strict JSON with unknown fields rejected
      validation_explanation_response_bytes: 32768
      failure: base context fails closed; explicit validation unavailable, 404, transport, auth, and non-502 5xx dependency failure omit only the additive explanation; Practice 502 corruption, 422 impossible identity, and malformed HTTP 200 fail closed
    rollout: Practice safe consumer -> Validation additive producer -> Practice persisted projection -> Teacher consumer
  dialog_teacher_request:
    service: ms-go-dialog
    runtime_status: composed for general, selected-text lesson, and action contexts
    trigger:
      transport: NATS JetStream
      stream: DIALOG_EVENTS
      subject: dialog.teacher.requested
      schema_versions: [1, 2]
      current_schema_version: 2
      contains: [event identity, dialog identity, source message identity and sequence, source channel, student_id, personal_teacher_id, educational context, optional learning_action_id]
      v2_additions: [positive teacher_turn_sequence, canonical_student_message_id, correlation_id, causation_id, optional action_receipt_id, optional source_message_version, optional reply_to_message_id]
      v2_forbidden: [student_command_id]
      excludes: [message body, mastery, unrestricted history]
    provisioning:
      method: PUT
      path: /internal/v1/teacher-dialog/ensure
      space_key: configured DIALOG_SPACE_KEY; default platform
      identity: authenticated student plus canonical PersonalTeacher only
      semantics: idempotent per student, teacher, and educational context binding
    bounded_read:
      method: GET
      path: /internal/v1/teacher-dialog/{dialogID}/request/{sourceMessageID}
      authentication: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
      query: exact personal_teacher_id plus 0 to 49 prior messages
      response: exact source as the last message; at most 50 ordered visible messages
      lesson_source: exact lesson-message-context.v1 or lesson-message-context.v2 overview/selection; legacy history remains readable
      lesson_source_v2: exact schema, mode, course_id, lesson_id, UUID content_revision, learning_path_id, learning_path_item_id, content_digest; selected_text only for selection at most 12000 runes
      lesson_source_v2_validation: partial or cross-schema fields reject; every anchor matches Student assigned projection before bounded prompt use
    idempotent_append:
      method: POST
      path: /internal/v1/teacher-dialog/{dialogID}/message
      authentication: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
      request: bound personal_teacher_id, exact source_message_id, stable UUID idempotency_key, body
      response: committed PersonalTeacher-authored message replying to the exact source
    coordinated_append_s5:
      method: POST
      path: /internal/v1/teacher-dialog/{dialogID}/message
      request: ordinary bound response command plus optional registry-built assistant_ui; idempotency_key is the durable response_command_id
      response: committed body and exact digest-equivalent assistant_ui; no browser-supplied metadata
    assistant_ui_source:
      method: POST
      path: /internal/v1/teacher-dialog/{dialogID}/assistant-ui-source
      request: exact student_id, personal_teacher_id, and message_id
      response_schema: dialog-assistant-ui-source.v1 with body-free frozen message sequence/version and assistant_ui
    canonical_student_turn_materialization:
      method: POST
      path: /internal/v1/teacher-dialog/{dialogID}/canonical-student-turn
      schema: canonical-student-turn-materialization.v1
      semantics: resolve one server-computed frozen UI action into one canonical Student message; command UUID is stable and replay-safe
      evidence: canonical-student-turn-interaction.v1/teacher_action_receipt; no label, value, answer, or Student command identity
      response: canonical committed Student-authored message; Dialog emits ordinary dialog.teacher.requested v2
    proactive_append:
      method: POST
      path: /internal/v1/teacher-dialog/{dialogID}/proactive-message
      request: bound personal_teacher_id, analytics event_id as the stable idempotency_key, bounded offer body
      response: committed PersonalTeacher-authored general-dialog message without a synthetic student source
    channel_append:
      method: POST
      path: /internal/v1/teacher-dialog/{dialogID}/student-channel-message
      request: exact bound student and PersonalTeacher, deterministic UUID idempotency key, telegram channel, bounded plain text
      response: canonical student-authored general-dialog message plus ordinary dialog.teacher.requested event
    reliability:
      timeout_default_seconds: 3
      maximum_response_bytes: 8388608
      response_decoding: strict JSON with unknown fields rejected
      failure: fail closed; no local conversation-history fallback
    ownership:
      dialog: authoritative history, ordering, author binding, idempotent append, and realtime
      teacher: pedagogy, task context verification, response generation, and private delivery workflow only
  course_lesson_selection:
    service: ms-go-course
    transport: HTTP
    authentication: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
    method: GET
    path: /internal/lesson/{lessonID}/teacher-context?language={teacherLanguage}
    revision: current lesson updated_at; not immutable history
    verification: exact revision match and exact selected_text substring
    model_projection: lesson ID, resolved language, revision, and selected text only
    forbidden_persistence: [title, excerpt, description, selected text, Course snapshot]
  learning_planner:
    service: ms-go-learning-planner
    transport: HTTP
    authentication: dedicated exact X-Internal-Token for Teacher
    create_plan:
      method: POST
      path: /internal/students/{studentID}/course-plans
      request: goal_code, desired_outcome, optional requested_targets, constraints, Teacher-owned audit_refs, INITIAL|REPLAN reason, and UUID Idempotency-Key
      excludes: [mastery, evidence, current path, generated curriculum]
      response: asynchronous request identity/status and optional already-terminal result
    learning_readiness:
      method: POST
      path: /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-readiness
      request_schema: learning-readiness-request.v1
      request: exact expected_state_ref only; student identity is in the path
      excludes: [profile, graph, mastery, evidence, current path, idempotency key]
      response_schema: learning-readiness.v1
      response: exact result, one reason_code, resolver_version, state_ref, PUBLISHED_GRAPH_RESOLUTION scope, executable=false, content_status=NOT_CREATED, and coherent optional goal or active_path observation
      bounds: request at most 16 KiB; response at most 64 KiB; strict JSON content type, no unknown fields, one object
      stale: 409 or mismatched state_ref requires exact Student receipt/state recovery before one retry
      failure: fail closed; never convert to no_effect, advance cursor, or synthesize a product
    onboarding_plan_handoff:
      method: POST
      path: /internal/students/{studentID}/onboarding-plan-handoffs
      authentication: exact dedicated LEARNING_PLANNER_TEACHER_TOKEN
      idempotency: stable UUID Idempotency-Key and immutable SHA-256 request hash
      request_schema: teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1
      request: [schema, expected_state_ref, dialog_id, teacher_job_id]
      response_schema: teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1
      response: handoff_id, ACCEPTED, exact state_ref and goal, execution_status=NOT_STARTED, content_status=NOT_CREATED, canonical readiness_observed_at, replayed
      bounds: request and response are capped; JSON content type and one strict object with no unknown fields
      conflict: exact 409 codes are idempotency_conflict, state_changed, or active_path_exists; unknown or malformed conflicts fail closed
      semantics: ACCEPTED is historical non-executable admission and is not current no-active-path proof or a reservation; S9 must re-read and atomically reserve before effects
      excludes: [Student profile, graph payload, course/path/lesson IDs, generated content]
      failure: 5xx/timeout retry exact command; malformed/422/hash conflict block; state/active conflict re-resolves only the frozen state and never retargets an intent
    outcomes:
      transport: NATS JetStream
      stream: LEARNING_PLANNER_EVENTS
      subjects: [course.plan.completed, course.plan.failed]
      schema_version: 1
      side_effect_scope: source TEACHER only
      idempotency: event_id is inbox and Dialog append key
    ownership: target/prerequisite graph, mastery gap calculation, Course generation, assignment, and Student path replacement
    knowledge_tree_dependency: no separate service; this integration is the canonical planning boundary
  ai_prompt_teacher_response:
    service: ms-go-ai-prompt
    transport: HTTP
    authentication: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
    execute:
      method: POST
      path: /api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential
      template_code: teacher.response.v1
      response_schema_code: teacher.response.v1
      variables: [teacher_profile, teaching_plan, student_context, dialog_context]
      teacher_profile: PersonalTeacher settings plus the exact per-student TeacherSoul nested as untrusted data
      teaching_plan: deterministic policy, selected method code/version, method-neutral stage, strategy, action, and help ceiling
      student_context: optional code_context is Student-sanitized untrusted text; its validation field is the only bounded test/validator truth
      provider_override: forbidden
      schema_override: forbidden
      idempotency_key: dialog.teacher.requested event_id
    replay:
      method: GET
      path: /api/v1/prompts/confidential-executions/{eventID}
      semantics: returns only an unexpired successful strict result; pending, failed, expired, and missing executions are not found
    reliability:
      timeout_default_seconds: 70
      maximum_response_bytes: 262144
      response_decoding: strict JSON with unknown fields rejected
      conflict: replay the committed successful result by the same event_id; if absent, retry the durable job
    privacy:
      teacher_persistence: pending parsed body only until Dialog delivery
      forbidden: [prompt variables, rendered prompts, raw provider response, prompt hash, chain-of-thought]
    onboarding_semantic_s4:
      execute:
        method: POST
        path: /api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential
        template_code: teacher.onboarding-semantic.v1
        response_schema_code: teacher.onboarding-semantic.v1
        idempotency_key: caller-issued causal ai_execution_id UUID
        variables: [student_turn, onboarding_state, dialog_context, semantic_stage]
      replay:
        method: GET
        path: /api/v1/prompts/confidential-executions/{aiExecutionID}
        semantics: only an unexpired successful cached strict result is accepted
      result: exact schema, response, slot_candidates, questions, and uncertainties; typed closed slot values only
      bounds: variables at most 64 KiB; student turn 4000 runes; dialog context 4000 runes; active prompt 2000 runes; response 12000 runes; at most 9 candidates, 3 questions, and 9 uncertainties
      reliability: strict response and parsed-response shapes; 409 execution_in_progress is the only retryable conflict; capability_disabled and invalid provider output are distinct fail-closed outcomes
      privacy: Teacher discards provider/execution metadata and persists only the selected digest-bound command-or-confirmation projection before Student mutation; no provider envelope, prompt variables, raw model body, or unselected candidates
      s7: no new execution type or second LLM call; v2 may select multiple exact low-risk candidates atomically; all product claims are deterministic Teacher policy
  learning_analytics:
    service: ms-go-statistic
    transport: NATS JetStream
    stream: LEARNING_ANALYTICS_EVENTS
    subject: learning.activity.interesting
    schema_version: 1
    semantics: best-effort bounded observation after telemetry acceptance; Teacher independently chooses intervene or stay_silent
    idempotency: source event_id is the Teacher inbox and Dialog append key
    excludes: [student code, compiler output, raw error, mastery, dialog history]
  learning_analytics_summary:
    service: ms-go-statistic
    transport: HTTP
    authentication: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
    method: GET
    path: /internal/v1/students/{studentID}/learning-sessions/{analyticsSessionID}/summary
    semantics: bounded active-time and activity counters for one exact analytics session; not mastery evidence
    policy_version: learning-analytics-active-time-v1
    reliability:
      timeout_default_seconds: 3
      maximum_response_bytes: 1048576
      response_decoding: strict JSON with unknown fields rejected
      failure: fail closed; missing analytics summary does not synthesize a learning-session result
  telegram:
    service: Telegram Bot API
    webhook:
      method: POST
      path: /integrations/telegram/webhook
      authentication: exact X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token
      scope: private non-bot text messages only; update_id is the stable inbound identity
    outbound:
      method: POST
      path: /bot{token}/sendMessage
      parse_mode: none
      reliability: durable leased delivery with exponential retry; ambiguous provider acknowledgements are at least once
    privacy:
      stored: numeric Telegram user/chat binding and pending delivery body
      forbidden: bot token, webhook secret, Telegram profile, separate conversation history
deferred:
  - full-lesson model context beyond the bounded verified overview or selected fragment
